system.description:
Requirements: Training (1) in Engineering, and you must be trained by another Urderic Smith or have access to their teachings

Ur-stones are an unstable, dangerous magical compound, but for those who learn how to control and craft with them, they can be a potent power-source for just about anything.

You can craft and use Urderic devices. How many you can use at once depends on the Power Consumption of the device, vs the Power Capacity of your Power Armor, a special suit designed to power your devices while protecting you from the deadlier effects of Ur-stones. You can remove devices freely and can equip new ones when you complete a Long Rest.

If you ever have enough devices equipped to exceed the Power Capacity of your Power Armor, you must immediately make a Resilience check of 4:X where X is the amount by which you have exceeded the suit's limits. This check must be repeated at the start of every turn you continue to wear the extra equipment.

If you fail this check, you are Stunned until you remove the excess devices. If you fail a second time, you are Incapacitated. If you fail a third time, you die.

Long term side-effects of excess exposure to Ur-Stones include headache, nausea, sterility, mutation, and death.
